preconditions.condition: The gloves selected for use are clean.
preconditions.vqa_question: Are the gloves intended for use clean?

limitations: Visual inspection via a single frame cannot confirm the cleanliness or provenance of medical supplies.

postconditions.condition: Gloves are worn on the hands.
postconditions.vqa_question: Are gloves currently being worn on both hands?

limitations: A single frame confirms the state of wearing gloves but does not verify the history of the donning operation.

error_criteria.violation_condition: The user puts on items that are not gloves.
error_criteria.compliance_question: Are the items worn on the hands gloves?
error_criteria.applicability_condition: The user attempts to cover their hands.

limitations: Requires successful classification of the covering item.

error_criteria.violation_condition: The gloves used are visibly dirty or have been previously used.
error_criteria.compliance_question: Are the gloves clean and unused?
error_criteria.applicability_condition: The user has put on gloves.

observable_cues: absence of dirt, stains, or signs of wear on the gloves
limitations: Visual sensors cannot definitively determine clinical cleanliness.

action_updates.skip_impact: Skipping this action means the user will handle the dressing and the burn without the required clean gloves specified for the procedure.
